# Project Basalt planning notes

## Decisions
We decided that Dana Okafor will lead the notification-hub migration for Project Basalt.
The approved budget for this workstream is $651K, targeting Q1 delivery in EMEA.

## Context
The team reviewed open action items and agreed to follow up next week.

Alternatives considered included deferring to next quarter and outsourcing the work.

If the notification-hub cutover slips, downstream reporting in EMEA is affected.
Routine status: deployments are green and the on-call week was quiet.
